digest.component_or_area: GitHub Actions CI workflow / coverage collection
propositions: Coverage instrumentation is collected identically on three Ubuntu Python cells (3.11, 3.12, 3.13), adding ~34 seconds of runner occupancy per cell without distinct verdict since production code lacks version-specific branches.

Consolidate coverage collection to Ubuntu Python 3.13 only (the primary/newest cell paired with macOS) while retaining both default and integration test tiers on all four cells (Ubuntu 3.11/3.12/3.13 and macOS 3.13) to preserve behavioral compatibility verification.
A-B-B-A-A-B dynamic experiment confirmed coverage tracing (not different tests) costs 34 wall seconds median delta and measurable CPU overhead per uninstrumented cell.
OSS precedent check (Django, NumPy, SciPy) confirms consensus practice of selective coverage on primary or dedicated cells while broader compatibility jobs run uninstrumented.

Workflow contract tests must verify exactly Ubuntu 3.13 receives both coverage flags and all other cells receive neither; defect seeds (prior all-Ubuntu condition and zero-coverage) must make the contract RED before fix restores GREEN.
